svg.aria-label: Three panels, each a grid of words 0 to 63 in rows of 8, with columns labelled banks b0 to b7. Left, lane k reads word k: words 0 to 7, one in each bank, 1 step. Middle, lane k reads word 8k: words 0, 8, 16 up to 56, all in column b0, 8 steps. Right, every lane reads word 5: one word, read once and given to every lane, 1 step.
svg.text: Three ways for 8 lanes to read shared memory
8 banks, each serving one word per step.
Words are laid out in rows of 8, so each column is one bank: bank = word mod 8.
